svg.title: LP20 six-port endcap fit layout - pressure service unqualified
svg.desc: Dimensions in mm. Material 6.35 mm acrylic. No kerf offset. LP12 single-flat D cutouts diameter 12.10 mm, overall height 11.60 mm. Two M10 clearance holes diameter 10.20 mm. Existing perimeter and six fixing holes preserved. LP20 Ethernet double-flat opening: diameter 22.60 mm, 20.50 mm across flats. Pressure capacity and connector nut engagement not validated.
